comment: Iterate halogenation of a substrate named "compund 9" defined as unchlorinated tiacumicin B in the tiacumicin B pathway. Non subtrate: free standing orsellinic Acid, I, F.  The flavin auxiliary enzyme is no itdentified yet, therefore flavin-reductase SsuE gen was expressed instead.
